title: QLabs REAPER MCP tool output envelope
description: The shape shared by every tool result this server produces, in both directions. A successful `tools/call` returns `structuredContent` satisfying the success branch — `ok: true` plus a `warnings` array — and each tool additionally declares its own outputSchema, which the server enforces before serving the result. A failed call returns `isError: true` and `structuredContent` satisfying the failure branch: `ok: false`, a machine-readable `error_code`, a human `message`, and advisory `details`. Callers branch on `error_code` and never on `details`. This schema is the contract that lets a client handle any tool's reply without knowing which tool it called.

warnings.description: Non-fatal findings. A tool may succeed and still have something to say.

failure.title: Failed tool output
failure.description: Returned as a tools/call result with isError: true, never as a JSON-RPC transport error: a chord that cannot be voiced is not a protocol problem.

details.description: Advisory structure whose shape depends on the code. Never branch on it.

remedy.description: What the caller can do about it, when there is something useful to say.

error_code.description: The union of the server's own vocabulary and the bridge's brief-19 codes. An unknown code must be treated as a generic failure rather than crashing the client.
